The '''Load Lifters''' were a [[Band/Legends|band]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. They played at [[Junix's Joint]] in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], and their lineup consisted of three [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo]] players, a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Nalargon/Legends|nalargonist]], a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Drum/Legends|drummer]], an [[Arcona/Legends|Arcona]] [[strummer]] and a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] dancer.<ref name="TOR" />
